description: Lists a part's dimensions, or one feature's or sketch's: each one's full name, value in mm or degrees, whether it drives or is driven, the feature it belongs to, and its reference. dimension.set changes a driving one. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title, its full path, or its file name with the extension (e.g. part.SLDPRT, part.SLDDRW), which picks exactly that document. A name several open documents share is refused with the candidates. The active document when absent.

feature.description: Only this feature's or sketch's: its name or reference. Every dimension in the part, in tree order, when absent.
